favourited_at.description: When you made it a favourite. Null if it isn't one.

file_format.description: The file type, e.g. mp3 or flac.

last_played_at.description: When you last played it, e.g. 2026-10-15T20:43:22Z. Null if never.

play_count.description: How many times you've played it.

rating.description: Your rating from 1 to 5 stars, or 0 when it has none.

track_number.description: Its track number on the album. Null if unknown.

year.description: The year it came out. Null if unknown.

songs_removed.description: How many songs were taken out.

url.description: The playlist's page in Navidrome. Null on other Subsonic servers.

description: Browse your Navidrome music library: search it, list new, most played and top rated albums, pick random songs and read lyrics. Manage favourites, ratings and playlists, see what's playing and record plays. Also works with other servers that speak the same Subsonic and OpenSubsonic API, such as Airsonic-Advanced, Gonic and Ampache.
